limits: Objective certification admits bounded exact C2 sources on boxes of1..16 variables and8..128 digits; certificates concern one unique nonsingular local stationary point, not global optimization.
Compiled symbolic derivatives and proposed preconditioners are not proof inputs to original-source acceptance. An inconclusive curvature check remains unclassified.
Monotonicity admits exact rational sources and connected exact real intervals. Strict predicates retain the pinned pointwise derivative convention; function_range and global extrema are unchanged.
ODE checking retains individual-candidate/common-smooth-domain scope. Held domains that might be erased remain unverified; general ODE completeness and uniqueness are not asserted.

Algebraic identity preserves ordered enclosing structure, exact typed free symbols, true function classes, and owned Piecewise branch/condition representations. It does not introduce commutative reordering, held-expression simplification or general algebraic-number equivalence.
New public Python behavior and the fsym-python bridge still require execution against the actual extension; the independent source review is not a substitute for that gate.
